notes.title: Blink: Rogues Release
notes.content:
[h1]Blink: Rogues is going live![/h1]

For about one year in Early Access, we've listened to users' feedback and [b]we have rehauled the graphics, the single player campaign, and we have tweaked some of the mechanics.[/b] What's left, you may ask?

The same [b]sheer fun of, Blinking between lanes, to steal an opponent's Boss and Megahealth, or to kill a chunk of enemies while chasing the 3 stars[/b] in every mission! ːsteamhappyː

[h2]The graphics[/h2]
The new [b]lowpoly graphics were widely more appreciated[/b] by the users than the old ones, more in-tune with the game setting, and also way faster to tweak! Win-win-win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/f751c5240c913f66dda2a60103583a2e2f37df57.png[/img]

[h2]Blink & Flip[/h2]
We started by asking [b]what if we made a splitscreen shmup-like game, but with a twist: be able to teleport to the opponent's screen[/b] and steal his loot, or simply kill them? And so appeared [b]BLINK[/b].
Somewhere along the way we also noticed that if a ship had passed you, you either had to give up on it, or spend a lot of time flying around. We thought that maybe[b] laziness has its merits, and so we came up with FLIP[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/b0605da890e1682e108dab2d2688c17f1af9bafc.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
You don't necessarily have to be very competitive, all it takes is having a friend that you feel like punching from time to time - [b]frag them in PvP a couple of times and you'll feel instantly refreshed[/b]! ːsteamhappyː Alternatively, you can now play Co-op Mode, which will really test your collaboration skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/6dc20bad89e1b5ea718f5ebdba1405dce431007c.png[/img]

[h2]Singleplayer[/h2]
New mechanics aside, [b]some people really wanted a solo challenge[/b], and the classic shmup feel. We have quite a challenge for them as well, in the form of the single player campaign, that they can try to master by getting 100% destruction in each mission, and/or making it to the leaderboards. Funny enough, these are not the same thing!
And if that is not enough, we also have the [b]Survival Mode, run the entire campaign with only one ship![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/9a0b3f7c484fc20e39657c9737b4c2a6c40e54a4.png[/img]

[h2]Next Steps[/h2]
We're planning to add more content in form of maps and enemies in the near-future, as well as a Party-Mode: [b]create local tournaments of up to 8 players[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Survival mode and New missions added
notes.content:
[h1](RE)ADDED DEMO VERSION[/h1]
You don't have to [i]believe[/i] everything we're gonna tell you, you can [b]try it for yourself right now![/b] The demo is free, and now comes with an extra mission available to play!

[h1]STORY MODE COMPLETE[/h1]
We're happy to announce that Blink's single player campaign can now be fully enjoyed in both solo and co-op!

It took us long enough to reach this point, yet we simply wanted to roll out the best possible experience with each and every mission you play. We wanted to not only provide variety through uniquely designed enemy formations, but to also bring forth a solid mix of sharp reflexes and tactics.

Our goal was to create an easy to learn - hard to master gameplay that is quickly understood and adopted yet layered enough to sustain a challenge. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/63fc77b618daf32120bd91ea48b60e17b5aeec2f.jpg[/img]

[h1]SINGLE PLAYER SUPERSTARS[/h1]
Ready to take on the challenge? Of course you are!
The total number of stars is 30, three for each mission, set from easy (50% kills) to medium (75% kills) and finally to hard (100% full wipeout). 

As with the per mission and general leader board, we've added a special ranking for the number of stars gained throughout the single player campaign. This will allow you to not only track your progress, but see how well you stand versus the competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/6a9ecca3a609529a3987f63ac2a89322577241df.jpg[/img]

[h1]SURVIVAL[/h1]
You thought reaching three stars on the final set of missions was hard? Then how about cranking that up by reaching three stars for EACH mission, one after the other, with only ONE LIFE to play with.
Thats right, this is for the big boys and we're more than excited to see how well you can make it in this mode.

Each wave will drop you power crates, allowing you to shift strategy by changing your powers from both sides of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33602572/a1fcc5c1f6dbe514c43a4b8097715e13710d818e.jpg[/img]

Survival mode will unlock once you complete all single player missions and will be available through the mission select menu.

[h1]OTHER UPDATES[/h1]
Aside of the above, here is a changelog highlighting the most important updates:
[list]
[*] - New VFX added for weapons and special powers
[*] - Powers, enemy drops and score balancing 
[*] - New Boss ship added
[*] - A LOT of bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Major multiplayer overhaul!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602572/faffa126b0f0a60702edc3d8098440c5b23866b4.jpg[/img]

It’s been some time since we had an update and this next one’s a real game-changer: it literally changes the multiplayer gameplay!

A lot of the feedback we’ve gotten on Blink: Rogues was related to our namesake mechanic: the Blink. And the feedback we’ve gotten was different and often conflicting: there should be more of it or less of it, it should be more visible or stealthier and so on. But one way or another, we knew there was room for improvement. So for the past few weeks we’ve been (play)testing different hypothesis to make matches in Blink: Rogues more action-packed than ever before. Here’s what we’ve got for you:
[list]
[*][b]BLINK WITH NO HARD-LIMIT[/b] - Is your friend Jim getting ahead of you in the game? Now you can pester him by Blinking to his screen to steal or kill as much as your heart desires.

[*][b]BLINK + SPECIAL POWERS = ♥[/b] - Jim won’t know what hit him when the moment you Blink to his screen, your EMP power activates! Special powers are no longer button activated, instead they activate on Blink. Before the match starts, you choose one power for Blinking to your opponent’s screen and one for Blinking back. Choose from: Invulnerability, EMP, Double Damage and Shockwave (for now). And then you’re all set for wreaking havoc the moment you Blink!

[*][b]FLIP MECHANIC[/b] - Did Jim think he was safe shooting you in the back after he Blinked to your screen? Not anymore! You can flip your ship to shoot him in the face! How about that, Jim?

[*][b]NO WORDS TUTORIAL[/b] - Wanna give Jim the surprise of a lifetime by mastering the new mechanics in Blink: Rogues before a match? Give our new tutorial a try. And never fear, the other Single Player missions await their turn to be revamped to match the changes we’ve made in multiplayer. So stay tuned for updates on that front![/list]
Let us know what you think and good luck chasing and fragging your friends!

notes.title: Mission 5: Fooled Me Once is a GO!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602572/fd79ae0a53e8b3fa2a736b8ae3dbd0e43ce4f0e3.jpg[/img]

Do you wonder what else is in store for Lucius Ahalla? Or maybe you want a fresh new challenge in Single Player mode? We've got just the thing for you:
[list]
[*][b]NEW MISSION[/b] - The 5th installment of Ahalla's story is now available to play. Finish the mission and increase your global leaderboard standing!

[*][b]ACHIEVEMENTS UNLOCKED[/b] - You've got a highscore to be proud of, but have you completed all the achievements? There's 14 of them up for grabs now!

[*][b]INTERFACE & STORE LOCALIZATION[/b] - now available in Spanish and German, as well. As before, please give us a shout if you encounter any translation mistakes.[/list]
Let us know what you think and savor the challenge!

notes.title: There's a new BOSS in town!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602572/11da7af48e8054328629f2ee9c992e95fbac8e83.png[/img]

One of the frequent feedback bits we got regarding the Single Player mode was that the gameplay could be improved, especially concerning bosses, so we moved that to the top of the update queue. Not gonna lie, creating and introducing new bosses is a fun process for us as well!

So here's the content of our second update:
[list]
[*][b]VIBRANT NEW BOSS[/b] - for Mission 4: Pathfinding. It has Dual Sound Cannons and a Shockwave Power you might recognize from multiplayer matches. We hope you enjoy the challenge and we're waiting for your feedback!

[*][b]INTERFACE & STORE LOCALIZATION[/b] - now available in Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, French and Russian. Since we are not quintilingual please give us a shout if you encounter any translation mistakes.[/list]
Let us know what you think and mind the shockwaves!

notes.title: Introducing the global leaderboard
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602572/00a01293ca24f31fbf2e94b59a8371af8ffb3770.png[/img]

We hear you and we're working on it - improving Blink: Rogues following your suggestions and our outlined goals. So here's our very first mini-update:
[list]
    [*][b]PROGRESS TRACKER[/b] - an estimation of the work done and how close we're getting to the full release. It is placed in the main menu, you can't miss it!

    [*][b]GLOBAL LEADERBOARD[/b] - This is a new leaderboard for you to compete in! Start the game and it will create you a new entry, totalling your single player mission highscores. Even better, it is public, so you can check it out in the Community Hub as well!
[/list]
Let us know what you think, and see you in Top 10!
